family: csoai.cross-ledger-supply (0.1 = USDC pilot; 0.2 adds products, issuer_reported, reconciliation)
status: measured read; signature and timestamp are sidecar files
question: Where does the issuer itself publish BUIDL's deployment addresses?

tried.expected: an address list in the served HTML or its main JS bundle
tried.note: client-rendered shell: the served HTML has an empty #root and no data

tried.expected: Securitize help article on adding a token

issuer_list_evidence.note: Block explorers and data aggregators do show addresses labelled BUIDL. They are not the issuer's list and are not read.

evidence_kind_legend.STATE_PROOF_VERIFIED: A Merkle proof returned by the node was verified by this reader against the stateRoot of a block header whose hash this reader recomputed from the header fields (EIP-1186), and the proven value equals the plain eth_call answer. The header itself is not checked against consensus (no light client); on an L2 it is the L2's header and nothing here checks it against L1 settlement. A second operator's copy of the same block is compared and recorded.
evidence_kind_legend.STATE_PROOF_RECORDED: A proof was returned and its bytes kept, but it was not fully verified here — either it failed, or it verified against a stateRoot whose block hash could not be recomputed from the returned header fields (chain-specific header format), so the stateRoot is not bound to the block hash here. The reason is in the row.
evidence_kind_legend.OPERATOR_API: One operator's API answer. Not a proof. Where a second independent operator exists it is read too and two_operators_agree is recorded — agreement between operators is still not a proof.
evidence_kind_legend.UNCHECKABLE: The read failed; the HTTP status or error is recorded. Never a zero, never 'absent'.
evidence_kind_legend.REJECTED: The endpoint answered but the on-ledger identity (symbol / asset code / metadata symbol) is not the product ticker the issuer page names for that deployment; no supply is recorded against the product.

two_operators_agree_legend.true: an independent second operator returned the same supply (at the same pinned height where the ledger allows pinning)
two_operators_agree_legend.false: an independent second operator returned a different supply at the same pinned height
two_operators_agree_legend.NOT_COMPARABLE: the second read differed but the ledger/API cannot pin a height, so the two reads are at different heights
two_operators_agree_legend.NOT_TRIED: no keyless second operator was found or the second read failed (reason in the row)

sum_rule: per product and per evidence kind only. No cross-product, cross-kind or cross-issuer total is given.

reconciliation.why: no issuer-published deployment list, so nothing on-chain was read
reconciliation.meaning: the on-chain supply below has not been reconciled against the controlling record; until it is, no statement of ownership, AUM or NAV follows from it

not_evidence_of: AUM, NAV, ownership, redeemability, fund compliance
settlement finality, reserves, backing, or the value of anything
the fund's or bank's controlling record (transfer-agent register / deposit ledger) — not read, not reconciled
circulating or investor-held supply (issued supply only; no holder, treasury or module balance is excluded)
that one ledger's token is interchangeable with another's — only what each ledger's state says
any relationship between CSOAI and the issuer: target is not client, public evidence is not private connectivity
relationship: PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_TARGET_NOT_CLIENT — no client, partner or Alliance relationship is stated or implied
honesty: An on-chain supply read is not AUM, NAV, ownership, settlement or compliance. OPERATOR_API is one operator's answer; two operators agreeing is still not a proof. STATE_PROOF_VERIFIED means a Merkle proof was checked here against a header's stateRoot — the header was not checked against consensus. We measure and sign; we never tokenize, custody or sell an instrument. No investment advice.

iso20022_camt053_shape.what_this_is: A field mapping only: each per-ledger read laid out in the shape of an ISO 20022 camt.053 (BankToCustomerStatement) closing-balance row, the shape a reconciliation reads. No conformance is claimed; no message is produced or validated against the XSD.

field_map.Stmt/Acct/Id/Othr/Id: deployment_id (as the issuer page lists it)
field_map.Stmt/Bal/Tp/CdOrPrtry/Cd: CLBD (closing booked) — here: issued supply at the recorded height
field_map.Stmt/Bal/Amt: supply_decimal (token units, not currency; not NAV)
field_map.Stmt/Bal/Amt/@Ccy: UNMAPPED — a fund share or deposit token has no ISO 4217 code here; none is chosen
field_map.Stmt/Ntry: UNMAPPED — no entries are read; balance-only snapshot
